summary: NIFTY 50 on NSE_INDEX, which Arrow streams by token like any instrument: an ltpc packet as LTP, then a quote packet as an index Quote frame (no trade, book or OI fields; the change worked out from the previous close).

notes: An index quote packet carries zeros for quantities, OI and the trade time; no live index packet was recorded.

deviations.reason: The desktop sends the canonical price_change and price_change_percent on an index beside the web adapter's own change keys (change, change_percent); the adapter sends no price_change, which is not a docs key, so it goes. Open until wire's per-broker rule for canonical keys (each key's mode range or never, index and non-index apart; lead 2026-11-09).
